item.title: San Francisco Orders Meta to Stop ‘Allowing’ AI Child Abuse Ads
item.description: The City Attorney’s Office has asked Meta to explain how the harmful ads repeatedly ran on Facebook and Instagram. The company claims the ads are not under the city’s jurisdiction.

item.title: The Shelton-Alcaraz 3 a.m. finish at the U.S. Open was spectacular—unless you had to work the next day
item.description: Many spectators stayed up all night to watch the late-night tennis game, but they may have paid for it the next day. Tennis players Ben Shelton and Carlos Alcaraz made history at the U.S. Open on Tuesday, marking the latest-finishing tennis match in the NYC Grand Slam’s history, running through 3:33 a.m.
